signs.Aries: If you have found yourself under pressure, and are still surrounded by demands, then take some time out to plan a get-away with your latest love. You may need to keep this an absolute secret though, as others may try to persuade you that their problems are more important than your peace of mind. Give you and your loved one a break.
signs.Taurus: Your love life brightens considerably today. It is a good time to get to know people, especially if you are looking for romance, as others are very open and much more congenial right now. They are prepared to relax their guard and go out of their way to get to know you in a more personal way. Take advantage of this lucky break.
signs.Gemini: Your sweetest love is in the mood to pamper you and shower you with affection. But not in the way that you prefer; in fact, you may find it a little too cerebral. Nonetheless, even if you feel a bit queasy when they read you some of the romantic poems they have created on your behalf, at least try and show a little appreciation.
signs.Cancer: This day brings with it the opportunity to do something special for your loved one. If you have both been under a lot of pressure lately, then make the most of this lovely energy to try and enjoy some quality time together. Go someplace where you can relax, have fun, and just settle back into the relationship again. It will do you both the world of good.
signs.Leo: Life is not all about work, and sometimes it is necessary to regain a sense of balance if you have not been able to spend enough time with your loved one. This is an excellent time to put your duties aside and concentrate on enjoying some space together. Rediscover your childlike ability to wonder at the world and find magic in the simplest things.
signs.Virgo: Today brings a sense of optimism to life and relationships. If you have been feeling pressured recently by events that seemed out of your control, then use the positive energy in the air to relax, forget about your worries and cares, and make a concerted effort to go and see that exhibition, or take that class. But whatever you do, do it together.
signs.Libra: There is potential today for fooling around, but given the light, but less-than-lusty planetary energy filling the air, it is not a time when you can expect a great deal of passion. Romance seems to boil down to discussions about many facets of love and even technique, punctuated by a lot of laughter. But when it comes to the real thing, you may have to wait for a more suitable moment.
signs.Scorpio: Given the passionate energy filling the air, it looks like you can spend the day with your sugar honey doing all the things you like best. You can talk philosophy, discussing in riveting detail the meaning of life, how exactly the big bang happened, and who pushed the button. You can fool around, laugh a lot, eat too much, and then spend the rest of the night burning off the calories!
signs.Sagittarius: This is the day to bring a smile to your face, thanks to the wonderful energy filling the air. Take some time out from being the serious, responsible, disciplined, ambitious, self-driven workaholic that you are, and think about others' feelings for once. Let them know you do have other interests, and that your sweetest love IS one of them, honestly! You could score points by intimating that you intend to prove this over the next twenty-four hours.
signs.Capricorn: Today you can enjoy a good laugh and romp with a romantic partner without the worry that it is going to get all heavy and terribly serious. While you can cope with commitment, it has be on your terms, which may sometimes leave your loved one in doubt. However, they aren't seriously worried, as they feel just as flirtatious as you, and also don't want anything too heavy.
signs.Aquarius: If it’s possible to go somewhere this evening, then it’s a great time to meet others. Although you may not experience anything too passionate, you will get a chance to know someone very well on a personal level, and to appreciate their many wonderful qualities and sense of humor. It will give you time to discover all the things you have in common and how much you could potentially share.
signs.Pisces: Relationship matters take a turn for the better today. You feel an easy optimism returning like the dawn of a new day. It is a great time to plan to do something that is fun, while also expanding your options as a couple. It may be a good idea to settle down with some travel brochures and plan a romantic break somewhere exotic.
